author: billmac3
text:
Hi H - Thanks for the interpretation. I originally thought
'incomplete' meant FTR hadn't hit its target yet and therefore not a FL.
 But I see now that 'complete' means 'no more clean orders in this FL'.
Does this mean that the FL is not useful anymore? If the FL gets
engulfed, does it carry the same meaning as before it was completed?
Thank you. Bill

author: HCDE
text:
billmac3 wrote: Does this mean that the FL is not useful anymore?l

I wouldn't say that, because it requires nuances.

Saying that price went to a clean set of orders in the MPL doesn't mean
that every level in the considered flag has been used up, they can have
been ignored, and therefore could have some importance afterwards. So in
 that case the FLAG could still have some importance, even if considered
 complete.

billmac3 wrote: If the FL gets engulfed, does it carry the same meaning as before it was completed?

And to your second question, i wouldn't say that either. Even if
something is compressed, the break in or out of CP can have some
importance, as IF already stated. You see what i mean by that?

@Dkd11, it's indeed how i understood it.
